properties.description:
2026-09-13. flo2 filed one friction — compare_designs has no budget_chars — and the sweep it prompted found 3 of 181 tools bounded and nine over the 30,000-character default. This epoch is the class answer rather than the instance: one shared helper (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/reply_budget.rs), nine tools bounded, two exempted as document-shaped and made to withhold whole instead, and a CI gate (tools/replies_are_bounded.py) that seeds a real design and fails when NOTHING overflowed.

WHAT IT MUST NOT BE READ AS INCLUDING: no fix for the server memory retention measured the same day, and no bound on the 143 tools that take required arguments — only compare_designs among those was measured. Eight further tools sit under the budget on this design and would cross on a larger one; they are a named watchlist, not covered work.
properties.name: Every oversized reply offers a bound — the class swept, not the tool it was reported from (2026-09-13)
